scope: The illuminated books as text, to start, by ruling: every one of them in Keynes's 1925 edition, the standard text before Erdman, with the Songs and the Marriage also as proofread texts. Keynes's three volumes carry Blake's other writings bound in with the illuminated books (Poetical Sketches, Tiriel, The French Revolution, Vala or the Four Zoas, the prose, letters and annotations); they are seated with the volumes and are not counted as illuminated. The plates as images (the Blake Archive) are not seated in this pass: QUEUED. Erdman's Complete Poetry and Prose (1965; 1982) is in copyright and is not seated.

why_seated: Blake asked for by name. The prophetic books are the one English body that builds its own mythology, its own names and its own cosmos and prints them as one object, word and image together: the Hexagon's nearest precedent in the language.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-18: "did we ever seat the medieval pearl poem in the originals library?" — "rumi, too - and gibran's the prophet if its public domain" — "and blake" — "yes, original language where available always, the prophet full, and lets do illuminated books as text to start. we can group those all in a single ea-corpora deposit, refer to examples, and they also do to alexanarch data and get spines and cards on traininglayerliterature's originals library".
